name: member-maintenance-new
js: const old = document.querySelector('#mt-panel li.list__item'); const item = old.cloneNode(true); item.querySelector('a.list__title').textContent = 'Water under the kitchen sink'; const m = item.querySelectorAll('.list__meta'); m[0].textContent = 'There is a puddle under the sink every morning.'; m[1].textContent = 'Oct 16, 2026, 9:00 AM'; old.before(item);
